_comment: The 'validation'/'rollback' sections below are historical, aggregate engineering notes from this pipeline's pre-open-source development history. They describe pipeline behavior/pass-rates only -- no candidate, job, or private benchmark-run identity -- and are kept as evidence of the design's validation history. Any 'backups/*' frozen-baseline directories this pipeline's own tooling may reference are private, gitignored, development-time artifacts and are not present in this public repository.

validation.v866_10_job_scale_validation: Batch of 10 jobs processed with full concurrency and zero cross-job state contamination; see docs/benchmarks.md for a synthetic illustrative example of this kind of run.
validation.v867_historical_ats_replay: Replayed against prior batches' ATS output with only the intended concept-alias rows changing.
validation.v867_offline_suite: Full pass across the offline regression suite.
validation.v867_job09_paid_retest: Single-job retest completed with no correction rounds and a passing ATS gate.
validation.pre_promotion_offline_suite_rerun: Full pass across 8 suites (test_v86_offline, test_v86_reliability_patch, test_v86_2_isolation_patch, test_v86_3_usage_optimization, test_v86_4_call2_effort_medium, test_v86_5_clear_winner_safeguard, test_v86_6_ats_bridge_and_unplaceable_evidence, test_v86_7_ats_bridge_reciprocal_rank_fusion)

legacy_orchestrator.note: rolling_queue.py is legacy V8.5 infrastructure and is not the V8.6.x production execution path
